Definition: a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela
BiblicalUsage: The word names the family of Bela, counted among the sons of Benjamin in the wilderness census.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the record of every family, and the Belaites are remembered because they belonged to Israel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
